subject: science
concept: Understanding genes, chromosomes, and alleles at a basic level
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Heredity) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges physical gene-segment pieces onto a chromosome model
exercise.pictorial: Student matches the terms gene, chromosome, and allele to their correct nested relationship diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains the relationship between genes, chromosomes, and alleles

misconception_flags: treats a gene and an allele as identical rather than an allele being a version of a gene

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
